metadata.name: bazaar-map

categories.label: Architecture
categories.description: Closed, supported massing and coherent facade construction.

categories.label: Materials
categories.description: Consistent scale, palette, roughness, and believable transitions.

categories.label: Semantic correctness
categories.description: Doors, windows, signs, stalls, landmarks, and props read as their intended objects.

categories.label: Grounding and attachment
categories.description: Props, canopies, trims, and structures meet supporting surfaces without gaps or clipping.

categories.label: District identity
categories.description: Each district is distinct while belonging to one Levantine old-city kit.

categories.label: Lighting
categories.description: Sun, shade, recesses, and contact shadows establish place without harming navigation.

categories.label: Gameplay readability
categories.description: Routes, cover, enemies, thresholds, and elevation remain immediately legible.

notes: V3 deterministic visual review cameras. Camera coordinates use design x/east, y/north, z/up.
The required inventory is twelve core views plus four closeups; synthetic compare shots are forbidden.
Audit captures are excluded from the sixteen-shot signoff inventory and require explicit SHOT_IDS selection.

Automated acceptance rejects camera drift, wrong asset identity, proxy duplication, grounding/scale/material/shadow errors, artifacts, sky-only frames, duplicate viewpoints, and runtime warnings. Automated checks never approve the map.

opening rhythm frames rather than narrows the central route
distinct wall materials separate the two building identities

shots.label: Service South east frontage coverage
shots.description: Oblique player-eye audit of the long east service wall and its transition into Caravan Court.
reviewFocus: the long wall has measured, datum-aligned relief
service rhythm stays calmer than the market core
the north traversal opening remains visually unblocked

shots.label: Caravan Court east frontage coverage
shots.description: Player-eye audit of the split east wall around the authored mid connector.
reviewFocus: both supported wall runs carry generated architectural relief
the five-metre connector gap remains explicit
the two facade identities do not collapse into one material

shots.label: Dyers Alley east frontage coverage
shots.description: Oblique player-eye audit of the previously bare full-height east alley wall.
reviewFocus: the long alley wall has repeated but non-blank relief
service articulation retains a readable route edge
relief remains grounded on the unchanged collision wall

shots.label: Covered Souk south frontage coverage
shots.description: Player-eye audit of the previously bare south return beside the covered market route.
reviewFocus: the supported south wall run carries generated architectural relief
the return reads as part of the bazaar rather than a blank blockout cap
the adjacent route opening and arcade remain legible

shots.label: Spice Street west frontage elevation
shots.description: Near-flat-on elevation of the whole west merchant frontage at a distance where bay rhythm, datum lines and vertical alignment are legible. Composition camera; oblique and close-range views cannot show these defects.
reviewFocus: overhead spans and signs attach above the opening heads, never across them
ground bay centerlines align with the upper-storey window centerlines
bay widths, pier widths and spacings read as a repeating series
one bay serves one function; no stall sharing a bay with a door or shutters

shots.label: Spawn A rear boundary elevation
shots.description: Near-flat-on player-eye elevation of the whole southern rear boundary of the A spawn courtyard, at the distance where the boundary's massing, landmark, and skyline read as one composition.
reviewFocus: the rear boundary reads as built architecture, not a sealed blank wall
a single dominant landmark anchors the spawn and breaks the skyline
massing steps, parapets and openings give vertical breakup across the full run
ground contact, plinths and dressing resolve where the boundary meets the courtyard floor

shots.label: Spawn A rear boundary west oblique
shots.description: Oblique player-eye view across the south-west corner of the A spawn courtyard, where the rear boundary turns into the west courtyard edge.
reviewFocus: depth in the rear boundary is real geometry, not applied relief
the south-west corner is resolved rather than a mitred blank return
props and dressing sit against the wall base with believable contact

shots.label: Spawn A rear boundary east oblique
shots.description: Oblique player-eye view across the south-east corner of the A spawn courtyard, mirroring the west oblique.
reviewFocus: the boundary run has varied bay rhythm rather than one repeated module
the south-east corner is resolved rather than a mitred blank return
shadow and contact separate the boundary from the courtyard ground

shots.label: Spawn A rear landmark close inspection
shots.description: Close upward player-eye inspection of the A spawn rear landmark: its base, ground contact, opening depth, attachments and skyline termination.
reviewFocus: the landmark has real opening depth, reveals, thickness and finished edges
base, threshold and plinth meet the courtyard floor without gaps or floating
attachments, fixtures and dressing belong to the landmark rather than sitting on it
material scale reads correctly at close range

shots.label: Spawn A west courtyard elevation
shots.description: Near-flat-on player-eye elevation of the west edge of the A spawn courtyard, framing both sealed wall runs and the south-west connector mouth between them.
reviewFocus: both sealed wall runs carry built architecture rather than blank plane
the connector mouth is framed as an authored opening, not a hole
bay rhythm and datum lines run through the whole edge
ground contact, plinth and dressing resolve where wall meets courtyard

shots.label: Spawn A west connector approach
shots.description: Player-eye view from the spawn point toward the south-west connector, the angle a player actually leaves the courtyard on.
reviewFocus: the connector reads as a built threshold with depth, head and jambs
the wall run north of the connector is finished up to the courtyard corner
nothing on the edge narrows or clutters the route a player walks

shots.label: Spawn A west edge south oblique
shots.description: Oblique player-eye view along the west edge from the rear of the courtyard, showing its south-west corner and how the edge meets the rear boundary.
reviewFocus: relief along the edge is real geometry seen obliquely, not applied pattern
the south-west corner resolves into the rear boundary rather than butting it
wall-base dressing sits with believable contact along the run

shots.label: Spawn A east courtyard elevation
shots.description: Near-flat-on player-eye elevation of the east edge of the A spawn courtyard, framing both sealed wall runs and the south-east connector mouth between them.
reviewFocus: the sealed run carries built architecture rather than blank plane
the edge has its own identity, distinct from the rear gate and the west backs
overhead and hung elements are attached, supported and tensioned
ground contact, plinth and dressing resolve where wall meets courtyard

shots.label: Spawn A east connector approach
shots.description: Player-eye view from the spawn point toward the south-east connector, the angle a player actually leaves the courtyard on.
reviewFocus: the connector reads as a built threshold rather than a hole in a slab
the wall run reads at the oblique angle a player actually approaches on
nothing on the edge narrows or clutters the route a player walks

shots.label: Spawn A east edge south oblique
shots.description: Oblique player-eye view along the east edge from the rear of the courtyard, showing its south-east corner and how the edge meets the rear boundary.
reviewFocus: relief along the edge is real geometry seen obliquely, not applied pattern
the south-east corner resolves into the rear boundary rather than butting it
hung and overhead elements still read as supported from an oblique angle

shots.label: Spawn A main exit elevation
shots.description: Flat-on player-eye elevation of the north exit face of the A spawn courtyard: the Spice Gate portal and the two wall returns that frame it.
reviewFocus: the gate and its two flanking returns read as one built exit face
the returns are finished architecture rather than leftover wall
the threshold, soffit and jambs give the exit real depth
the exit face relates to the three courtyard edges now built around it

shots.label: Spawn A exit west return
shots.description: Oblique player-eye view across the exit face toward its west return and the corner it turns into the west courtyard edge.
reviewFocus: the west return carries relief that reads obliquely
the north-west courtyard corner resolves between two built faces
nothing on the return narrows the exit a player walks through

shots.label: Spawn A exit east return
shots.description: Oblique player-eye view across the exit face toward its east return and the corner it turns into the east courtyard edge.
reviewFocus: the east return carries relief that reads obliquely
the north-east courtyard corner resolves between two built faces
the dye works corner and the exit face belong to the same courtyard

shots.label: Spice Street east frontage elevation
shots.description: Near-flat-on elevation of the whole east merchant frontage, at the distance where bay rhythm, datum lines and vertical alignment are legible. Mirrors the west elevation camera so the two sides of the street can be judged against each other.
reviewFocus: the east frontage holds its own against the finished west frontage
bay widths, pier widths and spacings read as a repeating series
openings have real depth, framing and closures
the frontage meets the lane with plinth, threshold and ground contact

shots.label: Spice Street east frontage oblique
shots.description: Player-eye oblique along the east frontage from the southern end of the lane, the angle a player actually advances on.
reviewFocus: relief along the run is real geometry seen obliquely, not applied pattern
stalls, canopies and goods read as attached and supported
the frontage does not narrow the lane a player walks

shots.label: Spice Street overhead run
shots.description: Player-eye view up the length of Spice Street with the frame pitched to include the whole overhead layer: canopy spans, banners, lines and their wall attachments read as one sequence rather than two isolated sheets.
reviewFocus: the overhead layer reads as a continuous rhythm along the lane, not two isolated spans
every span, banner and line is carried by visible structure at both ends
overhead elements shade the lane and break the sky without hiding the route
cloth has thickness, sag, finished edges and believable tension

shots.label: Spice Street ground and cover run
shots.description: Player-eye view south down the whole lane with the frame pitched onto the floor: paving, wear, drainage, thresholds, cover masses and their contact all read as one composition rather than scattered objects on a clean slab.
reviewFocus: paving reads as a laid floor with joints, wear and level changes, not one tiled slab
cover masses sit at authored edges and meet the ground without gaps or float
thresholds, plinths and gutters tie the frontages to the lane floor
prop clusters compose with the architecture instead of scattering down the centre

shots.label: Fountain Court south approach
shots.description: Player-eye approach north out of Spice Street into Fountain Court, framing the south entrance the way a player meets it: the threshold, its flanking returns, and the first reveal of the court beyond.
reviewFocus: the entrance reads as a built threshold, not an absence of wall
both flanking returns are finished and belong to the same order
the court is revealed in stages rather than exposed all at once
floor, plinth and datum lines carry across the threshold

shots.label: Fountain Court south entrance from within
shots.description: Player-eye view south from inside the court back at its south entrance, where the two flanking returns and the head of the opening are seen together against the Spice Street approach.
reviewFocus: the south elevation of the court has one focus rather than even decoration
the opening has real jamb depth, head and ground contact
returns meet the court floor with plinth and threshold
nothing reads as a hole punched in a flat wall

shots.label: Fountain Court west elevation
shots.description: Near-flat-on elevation of the whole west court frontage at the distance where bay rhythm, datum lines and vertical alignment are legible. Composition camera; oblique and close views cannot show these defects.
reviewFocus: one governing bay module; openings sit on it or the wall stays blank
plinth, string, sill and impost datums run the full length
ornament concentrated at one focus, never spread evenly
the wall meets the court floor with plinth and threshold

shots.label: Fountain Court west edge oblique
shots.description: Player-eye oblique across the court onto the south end of the west frontage, the angle a player advancing out of Spice Street actually meets it on.
reviewFocus: relief along the run is real geometry seen obliquely, not applied pattern
the corner where the frontage meets the court entrance is dressed and finished
openings have real depth, framing and closures
nothing projects into the walking envelope

shots.label: Fountain hero assembly and its ground
shots.description: Standing player-eye three-quarter view of the whole fountain with the paving around it, at the distance where the basin, its water, its plinth and the ground it wets are judged together rather than one at a time.
reviewFocus: the basin reads as cut and laid stone with real thickness at its rim
water meets stone with a wetted edge rather than a drawn line
the paving around the basin records the water: darkening, staining, wear
the assembly sits in the court floor, not on top of it

shots.label: Fountain Court east elevation
shots.description: Near-flat-on elevation of the east court frontage across its hero arch, at the distance where bay rhythm, datum lines and vertical alignment are legible. Mirrors the west elevation camera so the two sides of the court can be judged against each other.
reviewFocus: the hero arch is the single focus of this elevation and nothing competes with it
plinth, string, sill and impost datums run past every change of mass
the arch has real jamb depth, a resolved head and ground contact
one wall material per mass, with stone only at the dressings

shots.label: Fountain Court east edge north oblique
shots.description: Player-eye oblique across the court onto the north stretch of the east frontage and its transition into the north exit, the angle a player crossing the court actually meets it on.
reviewFocus: relief along the run is real geometry seen obliquely, not applied pattern
the frontage meets the court floor with plinth and threshold
the transition to the north exit is dressed rather than simply stopping
nothing projects into the walking envelope

shots.label: Fountain Court north transition, approach
shots.description: Player-eye approach north out of the court into the Textile Arcade, framing the transition the way a player meets it: the threshold, its flanking returns, and the first reveal of the arcade beyond.
reviewFocus: the transition reads as a built threshold, not the point where one paving stops
both flanking returns are finished and belong to the same order
the arcade is revealed in stages rather than exposed all at once
floor, plinth and datum lines carry across the threshold

shots.label: Fountain Court north transition, from the arcade
shots.description: Player-eye view south from inside the Textile Arcade back at the court transition, where the flanking returns and the head of the opening are seen together against the court beyond.
reviewFocus: the south elevation of the arcade has one focus rather than even decoration
the opening has real jamb depth, head and ground contact
returns meet the floor with plinth and threshold
nothing reads as a hole punched in a flat wall

shots.label: Textile Arcade south entrance, approach
shots.description: Player-eye approach north through the arcade south entrance, taken from the court side of the threshold so the entrance is seen the way a player advancing out of Fountain Court meets it: the threshold, its flanking bays and the first reveal of the covered run beyond.
reviewFocus: the entrance reads as a built threshold into a covered run, not an unmarked continuation
both flanking bays are finished and belong to one order
the covered arcade is revealed in stages rather than exposed all at once
floor, plinth and datum lines carry across the threshold
